name: stator
description: Stator — an ahead-of-time compiler from TypeScript/JavaScript to native binaries (monorepo root)

scripts.test:asan: ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 just -f packages/runtime/justfile -d packages/runtime runtime-asan && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 just -f packages/runtime/justfile -d packages/runtime runtime-test-asan && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 STATOR_RUNTIME=asan node packages/tests/golden/run.ts
scripts.test:intl: just -f packages/runtime/justfile -d packages/runtime runtime-intl && STATOR_RUNTIME=intl node packages/tests/golden/run.ts
scripts.ci: node scripts/check-node.mjs && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run dupes && pnpm run runtime && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:runtime && pnpm run test:subset && pnpm run test:golden && pnpm run test:builtins && pnpm run test:leak && pnpm run test:asan
